caption: The drawing depicts a tall, wooden grandfather clock in the left portion, featuring a reddish-brown color with gold outlines accentuating the paneling on its door and base. The clock face is circular, set within an arched panel, and displays black Roman numerals and clock hands, along with a painted human face above the numbers. Atop the clock are three brass finials, with the case detailing including carved arches and moldings. To the right of the clock, there are two triangular decorative corner motifs that are adorned with pink and purple flowers and green leaves, outlined in gold. Below these motifs, there is a technical line drawing in black ink showing a portion of the clock’s structure, highlighting the decorative molding and panel shape without color or shading. All elements are contained within a rectangular, hand-drawn border on a beige background.
title: Tall Clock
